name: ai-control-center
description: AI Control Center — 个人 AI 历史用量与额度工作台

scripts.build: npm run build -w @aicc/core && npm run build -w @aicc/server && npm run build -w @aicc/mcp && npm run build -w @aicc/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @aicc/core && npm run typecheck -w @aicc/server && npm run typecheck -w @aicc/mcp && npm run typecheck -w @aicc/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @aicc/core && npm run test -w @aicc/server && npm run test -w @aicc/mcp && npm run test -w @aicc/web
scripts.desktop:pack: npm run build && npm run desktop:prepare && electron-builder --config electron-builder.cjs --win --x64 --publish never
